zh-CN.title: 发送前编辑照片
items: 选图后可裁剪、旋转翻转、涂马赛克和选择保留哪些信息，多图可逐张切换。
闪图每位收件人可看一次，展示 3 秒，不可转发。头像裁剪支持双指缩放。

en.title: Edit photos before sending
items: Crop, rotate, flip, pixelate and choose which photo information to keep. Swipe between selected photos to edit each one.
Recipients can view a flash photo once for 3 seconds. Flash photos cannot be forwarded. Pinch to zoom when cropping avatars.
